crop.notes: Whole 'Sporting Notes' column; only the first paragraph is about Allen. The others are a benefit for Charley and John Daly, a Steinitz chess decision and pedestrian Norman J. Taylor.

ocr.notes: Readable with scattered errors; covers the whole 'Sporting Notes' column.

title.suggested: Tom Allen's Concert Hall on Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat ran a standing notice under Sporting Notes for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening with only the best singers.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday, December 19, 1891, page 7. Recurring paid notice; the same text appears in records 828-832.

facts.fact: Allen ran a concert saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertising free concerts every evening and billing himself as retired champion pugilist of the world

notes: Current title 'Tom Allen in Prize Fight' is wrong; the item is a concert-hall notice.
